description: **The watcher holds the game only for the start and kill, not the whole job**: `harness/watcher.ps1` `Start-NextJob` (`holds_game`, lines 956 and 1236): a cmd or ps1 job that touches the game keeps `holds_game` for its whole run (up to `job_timeout_s`, 30 min), so the hang watchdog is off all that time; a script that launches the game and then waits leaves a hang unguarded Why: napoleon's scenes are such jobs; in the next job that changes the watcher anyway Raised: napoleon J2 review Later 4, 2026-11-04
title: The watcher holds the game only for the start and kill, not the whole job
